_meta.notes: Signed 2/1/10 and clerk-stamped FEB 01 2010, so this is the year-end report covering calendar 2009 (manifest calls it the 2009 Summary Report - consistent). Lines 1 and 2 Column A write the cents as a trailing dash ('1100 -', '736 -'); Line 4 spells the same figure out as '1100.00'. Column B cents are written as raised superscripts (13,747 with a superscript 85; 13,295 with a superscript 93) - transcribed with a decimal point. The form has both an 'Office' box ('COUNTY COUNCIL') and an 'Office Sought' box ('COUNCIL'); Office Sought is used per contract. Form arithmetic checks out.
